title: Dark Quest
description:
The original Dark Quest, fully remastered.

A powerful sorcerer has risen in the land, building a dungeon beneath the village of Darkwood. From this stronghold, his minions raid nearby villages, spreading terror and death. A small band of heroes, led by a mighty barbarian, dares to defy the sorcerer’s power. Take control, descend into the dungeon, and put an end to the evil threatening the realm. 

FEATURES• Control a party of up to 3 characters each with their own unique abilities: Use the unique strengths of each character and work together to defeat the minions of the evil sorcerer. Slaughter endless hordes of orcs & undead: Your strength, courage and strategy will be the key into wining every battle.

 

• Roll the skull of fate and reveal your twisted fate: The evil sorcerer will torment your soul for his own amusement, he will summon you in the sphere of judgment where you will be forced to play a twisted game of death, and can you survive his magic?

• Trade with the people in the village: Spend the gold you find in your adventures in the village to buy new potions, weapons and spells for your characters.
description_short: Dark Quest is a turn-based dungeon crawler where you command a party of heroes on an epic quest to defeat the dark sorcerer and his minions, and save the land from his dark magic.
